purpose: Teach: 農政/国民党/生育/深層/重度/照射/同和/音程

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、農政の地域医療への影響を医療チームで分析します
lines.en: Ren, we analyze the impact of agricultural policy on local healthcare delivery as a medical team.
lines.style: Clear, direct opening. Steady, informative tone. Professional but not distant. Even pacing, no hesitation — this is assured clinical ground.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、台湾の国民党時代の医療事情を医療チームで学びます
lines.en: Yes, we study healthcare during the KMT era in Taiwan as a medical team.
lines.style: Measured confirmation. Slight pause after the opening. Warm underlying patience — meeting him where he is. Clinical interest, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、子どもの生育健診を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Ren, child development screening falls under our medical team's responsibility.
lines.style: Same clarity as the first line. Professional assertion delivered without weight or pressure. Straightforward, grounded.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、深層心理療法を医療チームで提供します
lines.en: Yes, we provide depth-oriented psychological therapy as part of our medical team's approach.
lines.style: Calm affirmation. Slight lift on 'depth-oriented' — precision matters here. Patient, not hastened. The kind of yes that invites follow-up.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 重度の認知症患者を、貴院、診られますね、先生
lines.en: You do see severe dementia patients here at your hospital, don't you, Doctor?
lines.style: Polite inquiry with a soft underlying question beneath it. Respectful distance maintained — 'your hospital' as gentle inquiry, not challenge. Thoughtful pacing.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、放射線照射量を医療チームで厳密管理します
lines.en: Yes, we manage radiation dose exposure with strict precision as a medical team.
lines.style: Firm on 'strict precision' — this is non-negotiable ground. Professional without coldness. Clarity and care holding equal weight.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 同和地区での医療巡回を、貴院、おこなわれますね、先生
lines.en: You do conduct mobile health clinics in Dowa-designated areas through your hospital, don't you, Doctor?
lines.style: Same polite structure as line 5. Gentle probing — testing whether they reach beyond the center. Respectful but genuinely seeking. Quiet attentiveness.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、術中モニターの音程変化を医療チームで聞き分けます
lines.en: Yes, our medical team listens carefully to pitch changes in intraoperative monitoring equipment.
lines.style: Precise, almost technical. Close focus — like listening intently to something only the trained ear catches. Patient but sharp. The listening itself is the point.
